newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas slips slightly, unmoved by J-Block news.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas slips slightly, unmoved by J-Block news.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures activity was thin on Monday afternoon, with only one trade done for 25 lots.

The trade, in December, was done at 14 pence a therm, down 0.25 pence from Friday's settlement level. A futures broker said that the settlement reached between Enron and the North Sea's J-Block producers over J-Block litigation had not had any impact on the futures market.

But there was a sharp fall on both the futures and physical markets on Friday afternoon. Some players had put this down to the possibility that some news was due to break, with a judgement in a separate dispute between Enron and the owners of the CATS pipeline system due on Tuesday morning.
Front month July settled at 10.455 pence a therm, down 0.045 pence. And August fell by 0.16 pence to settle at 10.44, moving from contango against July into a shallow backwardation.
